title: Quantum Computing for Industrial Electromagnetics: Applicability and Case Studies in Solving Maxwell's Equations
summary: Computational electromagnetics plays a central role in many industrial applications but often requires substantial computational resources, particularly when fine spatial discretizations are needed. While classical approaches remain the standard, quantum computing offers the potential to accelerate large-scale simulations by encoding them with a limited number of qubits.
